reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Water Mechanics in Provincia!
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how water interacts with the terrain in Provincia. With our native sparse cellular automata, ponds are now more efficient and responsive. You can raise terrain, dig ditches, and turn on wells without freezing the game! Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

posts: We've enhanced the water mechanics in Provincia! Now, water depth updates dynamically with terrain changes, making your city-building experience smoother.
